events.title: Secret Areas Added
events.summary: The world of Forged Cards continues to growOn your journey you may be lucky enough to stumble across two new hidden areas. One of them even unlocks a brand new mode of play.The Ancestors' CallA secret competition has taken place for centuries, largely unseen. It tests not just strength but skill. This competition is invite only... you must prove yourself as a smith to earn a place. Those who find their way to the Ancestors' Call face great risk, but perhaps greater reward. events.title: Two New Modes: King of the Hill and Co-op Multiplayer have arrived
events.summary: King of the Hill ModeCurious how your build stacks up against another player's? King of the Hill gives you the chance to find out. Match your build against real decks and real items from smiths who have summited the hill before you.In place of the Act 4 boss, you'll find a rival smith waiting. Dethrone them in one-on-one combat, and you'll be crowned the new champion. Beware, other smiths are right behind you on the hill. events.title: Mini-Games Have Arrived
events.summary: Three mini-games have arrived to the world of Forged Cards discoverable upon your journey.Nagelbalken is a nail-driving contest at a village gathering, a test of timing and a steady hands. Shields & Swords is a taproom placement game played with your own run deck, where you claim squares on a four-by-four by placing cards, each element of the card is important: casts, colors, and inscriptions you line up next to each other all lead to a higher score.
